description.value: The Country Store & Liquor Store is a convenience and liquor store operated by Manning Park Resort, situated along Highway 3 in Manning Provincial Park — one of BC's most popular cycling corridors connecting Hope to Princeton. As the resort's on-site retail store, it serves both resort guests and through-travelers at a remote location where resupply options are otherwise scarce. Cyclists crossing the Hope-Princeton pass will find it a strategically located stop in a stretch of highway with very few services.
